objective: Construct a fixed raw guarded layout with two genuinely active occurrences where changing one switch changes whether equality can be dropped. Determine what is possible when only padding names span the cut.
status: Proved: On one fixed two-stage raw formula, changing a single guard can make a shared middle essential to satisfiability. Across a complete-stage cut sharing only padding names, every boundary triple is preserved for any number of those names and any switch settings.
title: One switch toggles the need for a shared middle while pad-only cuts separate
